categories.main_business_segments: Lingbao Gold Group Company Ltd. operates primarily in gold mining, smelting, and refining. Its main business segments include mining of gold concentrates and compound gold, and smelting producing gold bullion, silver, copper products, and sulphuric acid. The Group also engages in geological exploration and sales of mineral products and jewelry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced mining techniques such as short hole shrinkage mining and sublevel caving mining methods. It has optimized mineral separation and mining technologies and implemented digital and intelligent transformation initiatives including MES systems for mining, processing, and smelting. The Group also focuses on refined management reforms and resource allocation optimization to enhance operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include the Shanghai Gold Exchange, to which the Group sells a significant portion of its gold bullion. The Group serves domestic markets within China and international markets, including the Kyrgyz Republic. Its products cater to industries requiring gold, silver, copper, and sulphuric acid, with intra-group sales to its smelting plants as well.
categories.geographic_coverage: Lingbao Gold operates mainly in the People's Republic of China with mineral resources in Henan, Xinjiang, Jiangxi, Inner Mongolia, and Gansu provinces. It also has overseas operations in the Kyrgyz Republic. The Group’s mining and exploration rights cover a total area of 216.04 square kilometers across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Company operates as an integrated gold mining enterprise covering upstream mining, midstream processing, smelting, and refining. It controls the entire supply chain from mineral exploration and extraction to production and sale of refined gold and other metals.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic priorities include continuous expansion of production scale, internationalization, digital and intelligent transformation, and green and low-carbon development. It emphasizes exploration and acquisition of gold resources, lean management for cost reduction, and development of a digitalized business management system. The Group also focuses on talent recruitment and ESG system construction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of gold bullion, gold concentrates, compound gold, silver, copper products, sulphuric acid, and jewelry. Sales are conducted at market prices, with significant transactions through the Shanghai Gold Exchange. The Group also generates revenue from intra-group sales and disposal of smelting tailings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Lingbao Gold positions itself as a leading integrated gold mining enterprise in China with ambitions to become internationally recognized. It benchmarks against leading domestic and international mining enterprises to improve management and operational efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The Group reported revenue of approximately RMB11.87 billion in 2024, a 12.7% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of RMB699 million, more than doubling from 2023. Total assets stood at RMB7.22 billion with equity of RMB3.16 billion. The Group has shown steady growth in revenue, profit, and operational efficiency over recent years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lingbao Gold emphasizes its status as a Shanghai Gold Exchange certified standard gold bullion producer, integrated operations from mining to refining, and advanced digital and intelligent transformation to enhance efficiency. Its commitment to sustainable, green mining and robust internal controls differentiates it by focusing on operational excellence, environmental responsibility, and international expansion.
